name: Changeling — the creature types of CR 205.3m and no others
notes: Scryfall's creature-type catalog is not the official list: it also has Automaton, Brainiac, Chicken, Head, Mindless-One, Naga, Reveler, Rukh, Teddy and Urzan, which a changeling was given. The official list is TypeCatalog.officialCreatureTypes (data.js). Blinkmoth, Camarid and Splinter are official though no legal card's type line prints them.
